name: El Monte City Council Notice of Adjournment March 2, 2021
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL
MEETING AND CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS PURSUANT
 TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 54955 AND 54955.1

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the El Monte City Council adjourned its
Regular City Council Meeting and continued its agendized public hearings
set for Tuesday, February 16, 2021 to the Regular City Council meeting on
Tuesday, March 2, 2021 at 6:00 p.m. to take place at 11333 Valley
Boulevard, El Monte, CA 91731.

POSTED ON Wednesday, February 17, 2021 at 10:45 am by Griselda
Contreras, Chief Deputy City Clerk/Records Manager
